name: Libraries.dev
summary: Freemium React UI effect libs on npm (Beam, Orb, Gooey, Metal, Image, Voice, Avatars); Pro Studio excluded.

install.command: npm install border-beam thinking-orbs liquid-gooey metal-fx img-fx voice-glow bot-avatars

gaps: Free inventory is 7 MIT npm packages / 9 distinct React exports — below the 12-target; not inventing comps.
Site FAQ still says five free libs (Beam/Orb/Gooey/Metal/Image); voice-glow + bot-avatars also verified free MIT on npm and included.
Pro = Studio customization / Pro presets (Solo from $9/mo or $149 lifetime; Team higher) — excluded; no paid unlock.
img-fx requires peer `three`; metal-fx/img-fx need WebGL2.
iframe demos are playground pages (shared URL for MetalFx/MetalText/MetalBadge).
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Border Beam
components.summary: Animated glow that rides the border of a wrapped React child.
components.copyCode:
npm install border-beam

import { BorderBeam } from "border-beam";

<BorderBeam size="md" colorVariant="colorful" strength={0.7}>
  <YourCard>Content</YourCard>
</BorderBeam>

copyPrompt.text: Use Libraries.dev free MIT npm package `border-beam` component `BorderBeam` from https://libraries.dev/beam. Install with `npm install border-beam`. Import `{ BorderBeam } from "border-beam"` and wrap a child. Props: size (md|sm|line|pulse-inner|pulse-outside), colorVariant (colorful|mono|ocean|sunset|…), strength 0–1, theme light|dark, active boolean. Requires React 18+. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jakubantalik/Libraries.dev/main/LICENSE). Pricing freemium — free npm; Pro Studio excluded (https://libraries.dev/pro). Prefer free-tier only.

components.name: Liquid Gooey
components.summary: SVG-filter liquid merge: Morph, Move, Melt, and Bend between items.
components.copyCode:
npm install liquid-gooey

import { Liquid } from "liquid-gooey";

<Liquid blur={6} contrast={18} fill="#fff">
  <Liquid.Item x={open ? -54 : 0} y={open ? -34 : 0} transition="bouncy">
    <button className="round-btn">…</button>
  </Liquid.Item>
</Liquid>

copyPrompt.text: Use Libraries.dev free MIT npm package `liquid-gooey` component `Liquid` (+ `Liquid.Item`) from https://libraries.dev/gooey. Install with `npm install liquid-gooey`. Import `{ Liquid } from "liquid-gooey"`. Effects on Liquid.Item: morph|move|melt|bend. Requires React 18+. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jakubantalik/Libraries.dev/main/LICENSE). Pricing freemium — free npm; Pro Studio excluded.

components.name: Image Generation
components.summary: WebGL pixel-mosaic loader that dissolves into real images.
components.copyCode:
npm install img-fx three

import { ImageGeneration } from "img-fx";

<ImageGeneration
  preset="pixels-organic"
  images={['/img/a.jpg', '/img/b.jpg']}
  autoReveal
>
  <div className="card" style={{ width: 320, height: 320, borderRadius: 20 }} />
</ImageGeneration>

copyPrompt.text: Use Libraries.dev free MIT npm package `img-fx` component `ImageGeneration` from https://libraries.dev/image. Install with `npm install img-fx three` (three is a peer). Import `{ ImageGeneration } from "img-fx"`. Presets: pixels-organic|pixels-mechanic|sweep-gradient. License: MIT (https://github.com/Jakubantalik/img-fx). Pricing freemium — free npm; Pro Studio excluded.
